Group Risk Management Policy

GRP-POL-001|Version6.0|Internal

An unavoidable consequence of operating. The Group seeks to minimise it and has no appetite for known control failures left unremediated beyond agreed dates.

| Technologyandcyber | Very low | No appetite for loss ofconfidentiality,integrity or availability ofcritical systems and data. |
|---|---|---|
| Third-party risk | Low | Outsourcing accepted where itimprovesresilience or capability,and only where oversightis eguivalent to that applied in-house. |
| Conduct and customer outcomes | Zero | No appetite for conduct causing foreseeable harm to customers or undermining market integrity. |
| Financialcrimeandsanctions | Zero | No appetite for knowinglyfacilitating financialcrime,breaching sanctions,oroffering or receiving improper payments. |
| Regulatorycompliance | Zero | Noappetite forwilfulor systemic non-compliance with applicablelaw orregulation. |
| Data privacy | Zero | No appetite for unauthorised processing,disclosure or loss of personal data. |
| Strategic andreputational | Low | Strategicriskinherentinexecuting theplan is accepted;no appetiteforactivity that wouldmaterially damage stakeholderconfidence. |
| Climate andenvironmental | Low | Financed and operational emissions reduced in linewith published commitments; transition and physical risk managed within limits. |
